items.docs: Independent 2D path rendering: geometry, gradients, rasterization and GPU mesh preparation.

Keys retain their full Eq identity (not only a fingerprint). Glyph CacheKey
can be used directly. Entries returned by get/insert are independent frozen
snapshots, so eviction never corrupts a previously prepared display list.

A hit preserves the stored image; remove first when replacing a key's
content. Supports RGBA8 pages; float images are explicitly rejected.
Integer texel rectangle excluding the transparent one-texel gutter.

Brush-local coordinates map to current user coordinates through this affine.
`[a,b,c,d,e,f]` maps `(x,y)` to `(a*x+c*y+e,b*x+d*y+f)`.
The canvas CTM is captured at draw time. Invalid/singular mappings paint nothing.
CSS gradient geometry resolved within an explicit brush-local rectangle.
Image pixels define the brush-local domain; repeating nearest sampling.
Set image extension per axis. Gradients retain their configured extension.
Set image filtering; this has no effect on gradient variants.
Immediate 2D context with gradients, path clips and isolated compositing layers.
整缓冲重置为 `color`（忽略当前变换与 clip）。

Intersect with an image's alpha in device pixels. Dimensions must match the canvas.
Retaining the Image2D lets GPU submissions reuse its upload.
Intersect with an antialiased path clip captured under the current transform.
Intersect with a transformed rectangle; rotated/sheared clips use a path mask.

Optional state introspection used to append reusable scenes. Custom
canvases returning None reject scenes before any drawing/state mutation.

Gaussian-blurred circular-corner rectangle in current user coordinates.
Uses explicit display-sRGB color, current CTM/alpha/clip/mask. Invalid
parameters paint nothing; sigma below 0.001 uses an ordinary rounded fill.

Gaussian rounded shadow with independent circular corner radii (TL, TR,
BR, BL). Inset is the blurred complement clipped to the rounded shape.
Uses current user-space CTM/alpha/clip and explicit display-sRGB color.

Append a frozen scene, preserving caller state. The default replays
ordinary drawing methods; native recording retains the shared scene.
Draw an immutable shaped text snapshot; color glyphs use shared atlas pages.

items.docs:
Prepared scalable COLRv0/v1 paint graphs; palette/variation resolution
happens during ColorGlyphRun construction, not while drawing.

Draw positioned monochrome glyph outlines using the current fill brush.
This preserves per-glyph painter order; it does not shape text.

Begin an isolated transparent group. Opacity applies once when popped.
The layer stack is independent of save/restore.

Begin a group with independent mixing, composition and final clip/mask.
Implementations must support these options explicitly.

Content drawn in the group masks the existing backdrop by its luminance.
Linear canvases/GPU use linear-sRGB coefficients; invert removes luminance.
Request another animation frame; the framework can otherwise cache clean paints.
绕当前原点旋转；单位为**度**（与 Jadix `rotate_deg` / Svg transform 一致，不是 HTML 弧度）。

Replace the fill paint with an explicit brush-local domain and affine.
The current canvas transform is composed with the brush when drawing.
Gradient coordinates use the transformed path's bounding box.
Use an explicit brush on the stroke outline, including caps/joins/dashes.
Gradient coordinates use the transformed stroke outline bounding box.
Postmultiply the current affine matrix `[a,b,c,d,e,f]`.

Immutable resources or borrowed straight-alpha RGBA pixels for CPU/GPU drawing.
TextureKey is reserved; host texture-key resolution is not implemented.

Integer source texels of an immutable image. Must be nonempty and fully
inside the image. Filtering may sample neighboring texels; atlas gutters
provide transparent borders without extracting/reuploading glyph images.
画布逻辑尺寸（叶 CSS px；MVP 不做 HTML 那种 bitmap ≠ CSS 分叉）。

Explicit output mapping to a bounded RGB display gamut. Invalid/non-RGB
target spaces return None; HDR rendering itself does not call this.

CSS Color 4 literals: named/hex, rgb/hsl/hwb, Lab/Lch/Oklab/Oklch and
color() predefined spaces, including missing `none` components. CSS
expressions (var/calc/relative colors/color-mix) need a style resolver.

Evaluates literals, var/fallback, currentColor, light-dark, two-color mix,
modern relative colors and scalar calc/min/max/clamp. Maximum input and
expansion 4096 bytes; nesting <=32. Escapes/comments and CSS-wide keywords
require a stylesheet tokenizer/resolver and fail explicitly.
Custom-property token values. Caller supplies computed values/cascade.
Straight display-sRGB foreground used by palette index 0xFFFF.
Both compressed input and expanded SVG document byte limit, <=8 MiB.
SVG bitmap pixels per logical unit; COLR ink remains vector.

Prepared scalable COLRv0/v1 glyphs. Palettes, foreground, variations, outlines
and paint graphs are resolved once; drawing needs no font or bitmap atlas.
Conservative outline/control-box bound in baseline coordinates (y down).

Porter–Duff composition after color mixing. Plus modes clamp to LDR;
unbounded HDR accumulation is not provided by the current target format.
Multiply the backdrop by premultiplied source luminance and group opacity.
Multiply the backdrop by one minus premultiplied source luminance.
Zero uses sum(kernel), or 1 when the sum is zero.
Image continuation outside its pixel domain, applied separately to each axis.
CSS/SVG `fill-rule`。
Immutable font bytes, collection face index and user-space variation settings.
Character mapping only; this does not perform shaping, kerning or bidi.
Current user settings normalized through fvar/avar in font axis order.
Unknown tags and nonfinite values fail. Axis values clamp to the font range.

Synthetic contour expansion in pixels, before the glyph-local transform.
Expansion does not change shaped advances. Signed amounts can thin contours.
Negative/large expansion can produce corner/self-intersection artifacts, as
specified by Kurbo expand_path; this is contour expansion, not weight-axis shaping.

Keep namespace unique per FontSystem/database generation; CacheKey IDs alone
are only meaningful inside that database. Palette participates in cache identity.

items.docs:
Prepared outlines can be cloned cheaply and reused at any Canvas transform.
No font parsing or outline extraction occurs when drawing this run.
Positioned paths are read-only and retain individual glyph painter order.
Applied to each outline in Y-down space before adding its baseline.

Hinting assumes this preparation size is the final pixel size. Canvas
transforms still work but do not rerun grid fitting at the transformed size.

Optional exact F2Dot14 coordinates in fvar axis order, after avar mapping.
Requires exactly one coordinate per axis, each in [-16384,16384].
Overrides Font2D user-space variations for this run's outlines only.
Optional extra per-glyph transforms, one for every input glyph.
S5: records the same Canvas2D ops, flush → PathPipeline `jadix_canvas:{id}`.
Finish a software continuation without invoking the paint callback again.

Replay a wholly recorded canvas with per-path area AA. A canvas that
already entered CPU continuation cannot change its past AA decisions.
CPU readback and continuation use the GPU's linear-sRGB compositing space.

Device-pixel flattening tolerance for recorded fills and glyph outlines.
Set before recording; affine arc conversion happens at draw time.

Point-sample path clips when paired with AaQuality::Aliased, sample count
one. Set before recording. Whole-scene sampling configures both together.
S4 cover pass：线性 / 径向 / 锥形及重复渐变（hints / px-stop 仍 CPU）。
Device pixels to brush-local coordinates; identity for legacy bbox gradients.

1..=3: gradients; 5..=7: repeating gradients; 8: Gaussian rounded rect.
For kind 8, bbox is the local rect and center contains radius/std_dev.
Kind 9: same bbox/center; stop_t[0..4] are TL/TR/BR/BL radii and angle
is 1 for inset, 0 for outer. Kind 8 retains its original internal ABI.
Premultiply endpoints in the selected interpolation space (no transparent fringe).
Interpolate straight colors in the selected space and alpha independently.
Interpolation space; output remains linear-sRGB premultiplied LDR.

1..=4096 ordered stops, including equal offsets for exact hard transitions.
Offsets are in `[0,1]`, colors are finite straight display-sRGB, clamped to LDR.
Clones share prepared linear colors; geometry/extend/alpha do not copy stops.

Extended straight linear-sRGB stops. Negative wide-gamut components and
HDR values are retained; use a floating-point render target to preserve them.

Per-interval interpolation midpoint, as a fraction strictly between 0
and 1. None is linear. A midpoint maps to exactly half of the color mix.
Stop geometry/alpha interpolation are retained; invalid input is atomic.

A retained ICC transform for RGB/RGBA data. Profiles and transform creation
are explicit, never inferred from an untagged bitmap or the host display.

items.docs: Parse bounded source/destination profiles; output uses destination encoding.
Bounded ICC RGB source to extended linear-sRGB for direct float image input.
CPU-owned pixel storage, excluding lazily prepared GPU upload bytes.
Convert explicitly tagged CSS/predefined-space pixels before rendering.

Finite straight linear-sRGB RGBA, retaining negative wide-gamut and HDR
components up to 16384. rgba8() is an explicitly clipped sRGB preview.
Copy an exact, nonempty straight-alpha sRGB bitmap. Invalid dimensions/length fail.

Nonzero levels contain premultiplied linear RGBA; level zero is available
through rgba8()/linear_rgba32f(), whose alpha contract remains straight.

Copy a crop before prefiltering so neighboring atlas entries never enter
coarse mip levels. Draw the returned image as a whole image/brush.

Sample in texel coordinates (centers at n + 0.5), returning premultiplied
linear-sRGB. High-quality kernels clamp ringing to the nontransparent tap
color envelope and alpha `[0,1]`, preserving signed/HDR source RGB.

Explicit texture-space derivatives for one output pixel. Missing/truncated
chains clamp to their available levels, like a one-mip GPU texture.

Sample a validated crop with Pad extension, in crop-local texel coordinates.
Every tap is clamped to the crop, so atlas neighbors cannot bleed.

Immutable update. Existing snapshots remain valid; the GPU may upload only
this rectangle when the predecessor is resident and no longer CPU-owned.

Prepare a private complete/truncated mip chain. Level zero retains its
pixels; every other level integrates exact NPOT rectangular source areas.
Clones share the result. No lazy unbounded global crop cache is created.

Paint an entry through the cropped image pipeline. Inherits CTM,
alpha, clip, mask and group filters; saves/restores caller drawing state.
Invalid indices or nonpositive/nonfinite destination geometry paint nothing.

Shelf-pack immutable bitmaps in input order. This is an explicit snapshot:
clones retain page identities; repacking creates new identities. No eviction.
All entries and page budgets are validated before pixel allocation.
Up to 16 trilinear taps along the footprint's major singular axis.
4 × 4 Mitchell–Netravali reconstruction (B = C = 1/3).
Interpolate premultiplied linear-sRGB texels; transparent RGB cannot bleed.

Elliptical weighted Gaussian reconstruction, bounded to 17x17 taps per
selected mip level. Explicit mips preserve large minification footprints.
6 × 6 Lanczos windowed sinc, radius 3. Not scale-adaptive minification.
Bilinear samples in two prepared mip levels; footprint chooses LOD.

Filters operate on premultiplied pixels in the canvas working color space.
Gaussian samples outside the canvas are transparent. Matrix rows transform
straight RGBA, with the fifth column a bias; results clamp to LDR.

Coefficients must be finite with magnitude at most 1e6, so portable f32
evaluation cannot overflow. Invalid filters are ignored as a whole.

Original content over a colored, blurred, fractionally translated alpha.
Color is straight display-sRGB. Offset and sigma are device pixels.
Shadow without the original content, useful for independent shadow mixing.
Rectangular per-channel morphology on premultiplied RGBA; integer pixel radii.
Fractional translation, premultiplied bilinear sampling, transparent outside.

Effects apply once at group pop. Clip is a device-pixel rectangle; mask is
canvas-sized alpha. Both limit FINAL composition, preserving the outside.

Applied in order before opacity, mixing and final clip/mask. Invalid
filters are ignored. Device-pixel effects are bounded by the canvas.
Includes copied base storage and retained f32 mip pixels, not GPU/staging.
Includes level zero. A shorter chain is a deliberate LOD ceiling.
Nonfinite coordinates, or magnitudes greater than 10^7 user units.

Regularized set operations on filled regions, before raster coverage.
Zero-area contacts (isolated points/lines) are discarded.
Explicit preparation budgets. Failure leaves both input geometries unchanged.
Applies to input tessellation, intermediate fragments and output triangles.
Triangle tests and half-plane vertex tests per Boolean call.
User-space chord tolerance, in [0.001, 1]. Curves become line segments.
Resolved polygon area in user units squared, independent of pixels.

Operate on already resolved, non-overlapping triangles. Worst-case work
is quadratic plus fragmentation; max_work/max_triangles fail explicitly.
[min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y], or None for an empty region.

Boundary points of retained area triangles are included. Zero-area Boolean
contacts are discarded. No raster/AA threshold is applied.

Fill once with the current paint/CTM/alpha. Works with scene recorders
and custom canvases implementing the existing fill rule/state contract.

Lazily cached f32 triangle contours with NonZero fill. Use for filling,
brushes, hit testing, clips or Scene2D recording; stroking exposes internal
triangle edges and is not a Boolean boundary-outline operation.

Transform the resolved mesh without flattening again. Zero-area triangles
are discarded. Reflections preserve positive winding in to_path().
Leaf-pixel AABB scissor. `None` = full RT.
Non-overlapping triangles: render directly without stencil/cover.
Exact immutable vector stops; geometry/transform are in grad kinds 10..12.
Top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left, in device pixels.
Source texel crop; None paints the whole image. Must lie inside image bounds.
A tessellated fill with an image brush. Canvas prepares the inverse affine.

Tessellate 产出：与 the framework instance input 对齐的旋转四边形。
S3 产品核改走 [`PathTri`] / PathPipeline；本类型只留作极窄 stroke 回退与测试。
未旋转矩形左上角（与 `InstanceInput.rect_pos` 同语义）。
描边 / 填充样式。

When set, fill color is sampled from this gradient (object-bbox normalized).
`fill` still carries opacity (alpha multiplied in the painter).
PathPipeline 三角形（叶局部像素，y 向下）。

Position is a glyph baseline in canvas user coordinates (x right, y down).
Glyph IDs may come from any external shaper for the same font/variation instance.

A tessellated scene snapshot: reusing it avoids scene replay, font work and
geometry tessellation. Transform changes require preparing another snapshot.

Immutable snapshot of the buffer's visible viewport and prepared ink.
Clones share paths, page identities, hit-test layout and cluster metadata.

items.docs:
Override prepared monochrome span colors with the caller's fill brush,
including gradients/patterns and its alpha. Color glyphs retain intrinsic
palette/bitmap colors and their prepared foreground. Atlas-only text cannot
be recolored this way; reject it before drawing anything.

Share incrementally updated pages across prepared snapshots. Existing
snapshots retain old immutable pages safely when entries are evicted.
Selection rectangles in layout coordinates, split at visual bidi spans.
Like draw, but reports scene preflight failures for scalable color ink.
Premultiplied working-space values; linear for `new_linear`.

Straight float output in an explicitly chosen color space. No gamut map
is applied; negative/wide-gamut/HDR components are retained.
Finish groups and export premultiplied linear-sRGB f32, retaining HDR.
Finish remaining isolated groups and return premultiplied RGBA pixels.

Extended linear-sRGB working pixels, including normal Porter-Duff groups.
Non-normal blend modes and bounded imaging filters retain their LDR semantics.

Composite in linear-sRGB, matching the GPU. Pixel APIs and `into_pixels`
still export display-sRGB. `new` retains its legacy display-space behavior.

Integrate tessellated path area per pixel before each draw's source-over.
Curves retain the tessellator tolerance; brush colors use pixel centers.
Image/blur sampling remains independent. Default is the legacy sampled AA.
Device-pixel flattening tolerance for fills. The legacy default is unchanged.

One center sample for geometry and path clips. Set before drawing; this
is used by whole-scene supersampling, not per-path coverage accumulation.
Horizontal sample count. Equal to vertical for the original sampled API.
Same snapshot preparation with explicit shader worker/cache controls.

CPU-only preflight/replay/tessellation with an explicit target and instance
transform. No GPU allocations; unlike Vello this does not estimate its bump ABI.

Append to a canvas without changing its styles or state. The caller's
clip/mask constrain content; an optional outer layer clips its final output.
Finite invertible instance transforms are required. GPU recording defers
expansion, but rendering still tessellates each instance independently.

Execute the callback once against a recorder with deterministic defaults.
Clear, pixel IO/hit queries and host texture keys are unsupported.

Atomically replace recorded commands. Failure preserves this handle and
snapshots; no callback is retained. Uses a fresh validated command vector.

Clear this handle without modifying any clones or retained subscenes.
Unique command storage keeps its capacity; shared storage detaches empty.
Reset and change the declared viewport. Invalid sizes leave the scene intact.

Prepare a bounded whole-scene sampling domain. Each sample retains the
complete painter order/clip/layer state until a final linear resolve.
Layer effects scale from output pixels to sample pixels; primitive blur
already follows its local CTM and is not scaled twice.

Ordered rectangular sample grid: each axis is 1, 2, 4 or 8, allowing
1/2/4/8/16/32/64 samples per pixel. All samples retain clip/composition.
This is spatial supersampling, not a native hardware/Vello MSAA pattern.
Check built-in replay requirements without modifying the destination.

Recording or preflight validation failure. Built-in canvases reject failed
preflight without painting or changing caller state.

Bounds for retained commands, expanded work and remapped masks. These exclude
shared resources, tessellation, ordinary path clips and renderer scratch space.
Budget for owned copies of borrowed RGBA sources, not shared Image2D data.

Conservative sum of final RGBA payload bytes for remapped masks,
including nested instances; excludes staging copies and GPU conversion.
This is not a total process/VRAM limit.

Clip content to the transformed local scene rectangle. Filters may extend
beyond this input clip. False leaves the declared viewport informational.

None appends inline (caller alpha per draw). Some isolates and applies
caller alpha times layer opacity ONCE to the completed instance.
This outer layer's clip/mask/filter units are target device pixels.
Appended to the caller CTM. Scene set/reset_transform stay relative to it.
Explicit filter support budget in device pixels, not an inferred bound.

GPU rendering is confined to padded_size(), independent of the final
canvas dimensions. The output's visible texel crop is `[halo,halo,size]`.

items.docs: Rasterize just the requested padded domain into an immutable float image.

Filter a compact GPU domain, register it with the renderer, and return a
crop-aware image that can draw into later GPU scenes. CPU fallback is
transparent; use rasterize when a CPU bitmap is required. The renderer's
selected format controls whether HDR values are retained.

Conservative surface/mask estimate in bytes; excludes path tessellation,
immutable input resources, driver and command metadata. Hard ceiling1GiB.
Commands retained directly by this scene; nested scenes remain Arc references.
Logical replay cost including each occurrence of nested shared scenes.
Conservative count of full-target mask remappings, including children.
Combined save/layer/scene nesting bound, not a GPU stack size claim.
Retained path commands plus dash entries; child data is shared, not counted.
规范 `docs/drawing.md` §4 里的 `Size`。
CSS/SVG `stroke-linecap`。
CSS/SVG `stroke-linejoin`。
Additional SVG/Canvas stroke parameters, expressed in user-space units.
Logical cluster coordinates in the prepared visible viewport, before draw origin/CTM.
